findings.evidence: Diff: `pool:\n        value: ${{ jobs.pick.outputs.pool }}` and `attempt:` have no description; the removed lines include `description: "GitHub-hosted jobs counted busy..."`.
findings.fix: Add a `description:` to each input and output: list the values `pool` can take, say that `attempt` is the picker's run_attempt and that callers must compare it before using `runner`/`pool`, and say what an empty `pr-head` means.
findings.issue: The diff deletes the `description:` on the `busy`/`budget` outputs and adds `pool`, `attempt`, `namespace_busy`, `namespace_cap` outputs and `fleet-pr`, `pr-head` inputs without any. Callers depend on `attempt` matching `github.run_attempt` and on the value of `pool` (pr-build.yml:96, :1445).

findings.evidence: fleet-routing.md: 'This workflow change does not enroll or reconfigure either server. Deploy the Fleet broker and release with class/slot support before enabling these host capacities. Drain tauchonki before updating it.'
findings.fix: Move the one-time rollout steps to the PR description. Keep only the lasting procedure for enrolling or re-shaping a host (drain first; use `--ci`/`--max-jobs`), and drop 'currently'.
findings.issue: The last paragraph is a dated note about this PR ('This workflow change does not enroll or reconfigure either server', one-time steps to deploy the broker, drain tauchonki and issue Chris's invitation). Line 33's 'production currently uses 12' is a dated config value. Nothing will update either.

summary: The reusable picker workflow's new outputs and inputs, which `pr-build.yml` depends on, have no descriptions, and the diff deletes the existing ones. The new routing doc ends with a dated note about this PR's rollout that will go stale.
